description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Scan dependencies for CVEs and remediate vulnerabilities before Azure deployment.
tasks.reason: Security remediation is required in every modernization plan to reduce production risk before migration.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade vulnerable dependencies to minimum patched versions, document major-version upgrade risks, and verify build/test outcomes after remediation.

tasks.description: Deploy the Java batch scheduler to Azure Container Apps.
tasks.reason: The requested modernization goal is to migrate the current application to Azure.
tasks.requirements: Prepare and deploy ZavaBatchScheduler to Azure Container Apps using existing or provisioned Azure resources and align runtime configuration for cloud execution.
